parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RemoveSymbols
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove formatting symbols from the returned command output. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

Default value: false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs get-instance-console-output --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp1c1xhsrac2coiw0000 --remove-symbols false --region cn-hangzhou
